instructions: Create a distinct single-level two-row/courtyard study with a small shared service area.
Use original procedural geometry only; no downloaded meshes, textures or celebrity likeness.
Produce static review-stage models, not automatically accepted production assets.
assumptions: Dimensions are design estimates, not a surveyed replica.
Reference sources inform geometry; their images have not been imported.
Cultural and architectural fidelity requires human review.
review_checks: Keep the low-rise typology distinct from the multistorey study.
Check courtyard access, roof clearance and service-area placement.
